attributes.name: Druva - Unusual Data Activity Alert
attributes.description: Detects unusual data activity alert in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 4 – Ransomware & Unusual Data Activity

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 4 – Ransomware & Unusual Data Activity
meta.customer_usecase: Detects unusual data activity alert in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.alert.name == "Unusual Data Activity" OR druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
